title: 情報システムデザイン
subtitle: Information Systems Design
educationalGoal: In addition to IT knowledge, project management and business knowledge are required to build or use information systems. In information system construction, the user and the builder confirm the requirements for many items such as functions, reliability, shortening of disaster recovery time, and improvement of operability. In this course, students will learn basic knowledge about the construction and use of information systems.
advice: Information systems are created by integrating IT knowledge such as programs, databases, networks, and system configurations. In order to design a good information system, it is necessary to confirm the usage requirements for many items such as functions, reliability, operability, and operability. In design, it is necessary to consider important matters, costs and trade-offs. In information system construction, both the builder side and the user side are constructed by the project, so a project management method is required. In this class, students will learn the basic knowledge necessary to build an information system.
requiredKnowledge: Students should bring a laptop. The prerequisite skills for this course are programming, databases, networking, and system architecture.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain points to note regarding the design and construction of information systems.
Be able to break down information systems into components and explain the role of each component.
Be able to integrate each component into a system and set numerical indicators to evaluate.
Be able to explain the basics of development life cycle and project management.
Be able to explain stakeholders and their roles related to information systems.
Be able to explain the method of quantitative evaluation of information systems.

achievementLevels.standard: The following three goals can be achieved: 1) Be able to explain the components of information systems. 2) Be able to explain how to evaluate information systems. 3) Be able to explain how to develop and manage information systems.
